comment: Account-plan initiatives (detail dimension, D15): what the RM team planned per client group and fiscal year - initiative text, product family, target revenue, owner, status, due date with its fiscal quarter and half, and whether it is still open or overdue at 30-Sep-2026 (e.g. "initiatives still open for FY2026-Q3 by RM"). Grain: one row per account-plan initiative.
